item.title: High precision atmospheric GHG measurements for the Orinoco region: The Villavicencio Tower (VLO)
item.description:
High precision atmospheric GHG measurements for the Orinoco region: The Villavicencio Tower (VLO)
Stijn Hantson, Santiago Botía, Miguel Ángel Navarro-Ramírez, Diego Pardo-Buitrago, João Fernandes Amaral, Shrutika Wagh, Miguel Ángel Ramírez-Niño, Anghy Gutierrez-Rincon, Mauricio Salamanca, Armin Jordan, Steffen Knabe, Tarek El Madany, Karl Kuebler, Heiko Moossen, Michael Rothe, Christian Rödenbeck, Sönke Zaehle, and Carlos Sierra
Earth Syst. Sci. Data Discuss., https://doi.org/10.5194/essd-2026-831,2026
Preprint under review for ESSD (discussion: open, 0 comments)
Northern South America may play an important role in the global greenhouse gas balance, yet no atmospheric monitoring stations cover this region. Here, we present weekly air samples collected from a tower in Colombia since 2023, with comprehensive measurements of greenhouse gases and their isotopic composition. This unique dataset will help constrain regional greenhouse gas emissions, particularly cross the orinoco plains.
